51038586.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to recombinant human MD2 by SPR analysis

original_paragraph.Materials and Methods - 4.17. Binding af: The binding affinity of 17 or 28 with rhMD2 and MD2-ArgR90A proteins was determined by surface plasmon resonance (SPR) analysis using a ProteOn XPR36 Protein Interaction Array system (Bio-Rad Laboratories, Hercules, CA) with a HTE sensor chip (ProteOn™, #176–5033). The protein was loaded to the sensors which was activated with 10 mM NISO4. MAC 17 or 28 samples (at 6.25, 12.5, 25, 50, 100 and 200 μM) were prepared with running buffer (PBS, 0.1% SDS, 5% DMSO). Sensor and sample plates were placed on the instrument, and MAC 17 or 28 samples were captured in flow cell one, leaving the second flow cell as blank. The 6 concentrations were injected simultaneously at a flow rate of 30 μL/min for 120 s of association phase, followed with 120 s of dissociation phase at 25 °C. The final graphs were obtained by subtracting blank sensorgrams from the duplex or quadruplex sensorgrams, and data were analyzed with ProteOn manager software. The KD was calculated by global fitting of the kinetic data from various concentrations of 17 or 28 using 1:1 Langmuir binding model.
original_paragraph.Figure 5 caption: Fig. 5. Binding affinity of MACs 17 and 28 with MD2. (A–B) SPR assay showed the binding kinetics of A) MAC 17 and B) MAC 28 with recombinant human MD2 (rhMD2) at increasing concentrations (6.25–200 μM). (C–D) HUVECs were incubated with C) MAC 17 or D) MAC 28 at 0.1, 1.0 and 10 μM for 30 min and followed by FITC-LPS for further 30 min. These cells were collected and subjected to flow cytometry analysis; MFI = mean fluorescence index; n = 4. (E–H) Co-IP assay was used to determine the effects of MAC 17 or 28 on LPS-induced TLR4-MD2 complex dimerization in E-F) RAW 264.7 macrophages and G-H) lung tissue in triplicates; MD2 was immunoprecipitating protein (IP), TLR4 was the blotted (IB) protein, n = 4. I) The effects of MACs 17 and 28 in interfering with LPS binding with MD2 was determined by measuring biotin-LPS with rhMD2 using ELISA; n = 4; *P < 0.05, **P < 0.001 compared to LPS group, as calculated by student’s t-test. (J–K) The effects of MACs 17 and 28 in interfering with binding of fluorescent probe, bis-ANS, on rhMD2 was determined. Shown are representative graphs of relative fluorescence units (RFU) with increasing concentrations of MAC 17 or 28 (J and K, respectively).
